notes: 织风者套 (paired with the Glide Set in the Tier 2 card heading): no confident official English name found; translated descriptively as "Weaver Set".

暗黑套 (paired with 黑暗套装 in the Tier 3 card heading and shown as a separate image caption): appears to be a variant/alternate name for the Dark Set; translated descriptively as "Shadow Set" to keep it distinct from 黑暗套装 ("Dark Set").
马克兔: fan nickname for the player-built hover bike (Zonai-device flying vehicle); translated as "hover bike".
闪耀果 / 光亮花: rendered as "Brightbloom Seed" (the in-game light plant); the page uses both terms loosely for the same light source.
三级攻击药: rendered descriptively as "a level-3 attack-boosting elixir" (no specific in-game elixir name is given on the page).
白银人马大剑: rendered descriptively as "Silver Lynel greatsword" (a Lynel weapon type, not a unique named weapon on the page).
pairs: 王国之泪最强套装与隐藏特效全解析——蛮族套装、左纳乌套装、异次元恶灵套装等三梯队8套神装二星特效完整攻略。

A complete guide to the strongest armor sets and hidden effects in Tears of the Kingdom — the Barbarian Set, Zonai Set, Evil Spirit Set and more: 8 god-tier sets across three tiers, with their two-star effects fully explained.
《王国之泪》最强套装与隐藏特效全解析——三梯队完全推荐
The Strongest Armor Sets and Hidden Set Bonuses in The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom — A Complete Three-Tier Recommendation
谁还不是个换装达人？升到二星的套装隐藏特效，才是真正改变游戏体验的关键！
Who isn't an outfit-changing expert? The hidden set bonuses unlocked at two stars are what truly change the gameplay experience!
🛡 套装系统 · 升级特效
在《塞尔达传说：王国之泪》里，谁还不是个换装达人呢？但别忘了，衣服不仅是为了耍帅，它们自带的抗性、加成，甚至升到二星后解锁的"套装奖励"，分分钟能让你从"海拉鲁老流氓"直接进化成"海拉鲁战神"！今天直接抛开那些白板装，盘点开荒和后期必拿的神级套装，以及那些让人直呼"真香"的隐藏特效！

In The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom, who isn't an outfit-changing expert? But don't forget: clothes aren't just for looking cool. Their built-in resistances, boosts, and the "set bonus" unlocked once you upgrade to two stars can take you from a Hyrule veteran straight to a Hyrule god of war in no time! Today, let's set aside the plain unupgraded gear and run through the god-tier sets you must grab for the early game and the late game, plus those hidden effects that will have you saying "this is actually amazing"!
蛮族套装（游戏实机截图）
蛮族套装（游戏实机截图，图片来源：Zelda Dungeon Wiki）
Barbarian Armor (in-game screenshot, image source: Zelda Dungeon Wiki)
第一梯队：输出就是正义！流派核心神装
Tier 1: Damage Is Justice! The Core Sets for Every Build
⚔ 蛮族套装 / 鬼神套装（物理攻击天花板）
⚔ Barbarian Set / Fierce Deity Set (the ceiling for physical attack)
⭐⭐ 二星奖励：蓄力攻击精力持久
⭐⭐ Two-Star Bonus: Charged Attack Stamina Up
无论是鬼神还是蛮族，穿齐了就是1.5倍的物理伤害拉满。打人马、单挑BOSS，直接掏出你的白银人马大剑一顿大风车，有了二星奖励的蓄力减耗，转就完事了，盖侬看了都得喊救命！

Whether it's the Fierce Deity Set or the Barbarian Set, wearing the full set maxes out your physical damage at 1.5x. Fighting Lynels or soloing a boss, just pull out your Silver Lynel greatsword and spin away — with the two-star bonus reducing charged-attack stamina cost, all you need to do is keep spinning, and even Ganondorf would cry for help!
🤖 左纳乌套装（高达/飞机流的绝对核心）
🤖 Zonai Set (the absolute core of mecha/aircraft builds)
单件效果：降低左纳乌装置能源消耗
Per-Piece Effect: Reduces Zonai Device energy consumption
⭐⭐ 二星奖励：能源回复加快
王国之泪叫什么？《海拉鲁重工》！穿上这套，你的大电量直接耐用翻倍，二星特效更能让你在电池耗尽后光速回电。开马克兔飞天、开激光坦克洗地必穿，赛博海拉鲁人指定制服。

What is Tears of the Kingdom really called? Hyrule Heavy Industries! Wear this set and your large battery effectively lasts twice as long, and the two-star effect lets your battery recharge at lightning speed once drained. It's a must-wear for flying a hover bike into the sky or mowing everything down in a laser tank — the designated uniform of the cyber-Hyrule citizen.
💀 异次元恶灵套装（极致爆炸伤害流）
💀 Evil Spirit Set (the ultimate burst-damage build)
💀 套装奖励：骨武器伤害提升 + 骸骨伪装（无法在大妖精处升级）
💀 Set Bonus: Bone Weapon Damage Up + Skeleton Disguise (cannot be upgraded at a Great Fairy)
这套没法去大妖精那里升级，但它是全游戏单次伤害上限最高的一套衣服！配合吉波得之骨，或者莫尔德拉吉克的颚骨余料建造，加上吃个三级攻击药，乘区叠满后，骑在人马背上能把白银人马敲得怀疑人生。夜间还自带伪装，骷髅怪根本不打你。

This set can't be upgraded at a Great Fairy, but it has the highest single-hit damage ceiling in the whole game! Pair it with a Gibdo Bone, or a Molduga Jawbone Fused to your weapon, plus a level-3 attack-boosting elixir — once all the damage multipliers stack, you can mount a Lynel and beat a Silver Lynel senseless. At night it also comes with its own disguise, so skeletal monsters won't attack you at all.
第二梯队：功能性拉满的"逃学"神器
🪂 滑翔套装 / 织风者套（空岛蹦极指定装备）
🪂 Glide Set / Weaver Set (the designated gear for Sky Island bungee-jumping)
单件效果：俯冲机动性提升
⭐⭐ 二星奖励：完全免疫坠落伤害（跌落无伤害）
⭐⭐ Two-Star Bonus: Complete immunity to fall damage (no damage from falling)
堪称本作第一"逃学"神装。升到二星之后，无论多高跳下来，直接脸着地都不掉一滴血！不用再心惊肉跳地算体力开伞，空岛跑图、赶路下凡体验极佳，直接改变游戏方式。

Arguably this game's number-one "sequence-breaking" set. Once upgraded to two stars, no matter how high you jump from, you can land face-first without losing a single drop of health! No more nervously calculating your stamina to open your paraglider — exploring the Sky Islands and dropping back down to the surface feels fantastic and genuinely changes how you play.
🐸 蛙之套装（雨天蜘蛛侠，稳稳不跌落）
🐸 Froggy Set (a rainy-day Spider-Man that never slips)
单件效果：滑行不滑落（防滑）
⭐⭐ Two-Star Bonus: Never slip at all
还在为下雨天爬山滑下来砸键盘吗？穿上这套升到二星的蛙之套，你就是蜘蛛侠本侠！下暴雨照样在悬崖峭壁上如履平地，再也不用生火等雨停了。

Still smashing your keyboard after sliding down a mountain in the rain? Put on this two-star Froggy Set and you are Spider-Man himself! Even in a downpour you can walk cliffs and precipices as if on flat ground, and you'll never have to light a fire and wait out the rain again.
第三梯队：环境应对的特种作战服
Tier 3: Special-Operations Gear for Hostile Environments
⛏ 采矿套装 / 矿工套（行走的闪耀果）
⛏ Miner Set / Miner Outfit (a walking Brightbloom Seed)
⭐⭐ Two-Star Bonus: Leaves light in your footsteps
下地底开荒没光亮花怎么办？穿上它你自己就是个人形灯泡。二星效果更是绝了，走过的地方会在地上留下光点，相当于给自己洒了夜光面包屑，在黑漆漆的深穴里再也不怕迷路绕圈子了。

What do you do when exploring the Depths with no Brightbloom Seeds? Wear this and you become a walking light bulb yourself. The two-star effect is even better: the places you walk leave glowing spots on the ground, like scattering glow-in-the-dark breadcrumbs for yourself, so you'll never get lost going in circles in a pitch-black cavern again.
🌑 黑暗套装 / 暗黑套（地底保命装）
🌑 Dark Set / Shadow Set (Depths survival gear)
⭐⭐ 二星奖励：瘴气伤害减少
探索地底瘴气区域，或者打瘴气手、幻影加侬时的极佳保命装。它提供的蓝心被瘴气扣除后，只要在没瘴气的地方待两秒就会自动恢复，能帮你省下大量向阳草。

An excellent life-saving set for exploring gloom-filled areas of the Depths, or for fighting Gloom Hands and Phantom Ganon. After gloom drains the extra blue hearts it provides, they automatically recover if you spend just two seconds in a gloom-free spot, which can save you a lot of Sundelions.
祝各位海拉鲁老流氓们早日神装毕业，痛扁盖侬！记住：在《王国之泪》里，最强的配装永远是"合适的场景穿合适的衣服"，没有万能神装，只有最优解。打BOSS换蛮族，跳崖换滑翔，下地底换矿工，这才是真正的海拉鲁生存法则！

May all you Hyrule veterans complete your god-tier sets soon and give Ganondorf a good beating! Remember: in Tears of the Kingdom, the strongest loadout is always "the right clothes for the right situation" — there is no all-purpose god set, only the optimal choice. Switch to the Barbarian Set for bosses, the Glide Set for cliff jumps, and the Miner Set for the Depths — that is the true law of survival in Hyrule!
